scripts.text: - You cannot proceed because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续。 -

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
Hello. Adventurer.
If you're here to purchase Dynite mining equipment or refine ore into Dynite, you've come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
你好，冒险者。
如果你是想购买超神力矿石开采设备，或者将矿石精炼为超神力矿石，你来对地方了。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
{0} Refined Ore.
{1} ^777777(currently {2})^000000
{3} ^777777(currently {4})^000000
{5} ^777777(currently {6})^000000
{7} ^777777(currently {8})^000000
{9} ^777777(currently {10})^000000
You need one each of the five types of ore.

[Elmen]
I'm sorry. Adventurer.
Dynite Refinement can only be refined up to 100 at a time? The machine is small, so there is no help. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
抱歉，冒险者。
超神力矿石精炼一次最多只能精炼100个？机器比较小，没办法。请谅解。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
Cancel?
If you need refinement of the Dynite, please find it anytime. There is no one who can do it without me.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
取消？
如果你需要精炼超神力矿石，随时都可以来找我。除了我，没人能做这个。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
Hey! This makes it difficult for each other, don't you run out of materials needed for refining? The materials!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
嘿！这样会让彼此都很难做，你难道不担心精炼所需的材料不够吗？材料！

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
{0} Dynite have been refined. It's perfect today!
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
{0} 超神力矿石已经精炼好了。今天运气真好！

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
There are various accessories and modification permits. Look carefully at what you want before buying.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
这里有各种饰品和改装许可证。购买前请仔细看看你想要什么。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
I can exchange the equipment with the Dynite, but it's already in a tightly sealed box.
Give me 50 ^4d4dffDynites^000000 and I will open a ^4d4dffweapon box^000000 for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
我可以用超神力矿石兑换装备，但它们已经被密封在盒子里了。
给我50 ^4d4dff超神力矿石^000000，我就为你打开一个 ^4d4dff武器盒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
I don't know what will come out, but the quality is good. Would you like to open it?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
我不知道会开出什么，但品质很好。你要打开吗？

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
Kee, this is a waste, it was a good deal.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
哎呀，这真是浪费，本来是个好交易。

scripts.text:
[Elmen]
You don't have enough Dynite friends.
I don't know what's going to come out, so it's hard to go anywhere and get this kind of equipment at this price.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔门]
你的超神力矿石朋友不够。
我不知道会开出什么，所以很难在这个价格买到这种装备。
